title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
4 x Customer Service Advisors

Location: Luton

Salary: Up to 27,000

Contract: 6-month Fixed-Term Contract

This is a great opportunity for customer-focused individuals who enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, take pride in getting the details right and enjoy working with different teams to ensure customers receive an excellent level of service.

You'll play an important role in the day-to day running of the customer service function, supporting customers and internal teams with orders, deliveries, queries and any issues that arise along the way.

- Processing customer sales and sample orders accurately and efficiently.

- Previous experience in a customer service or customer care role, preferably within an office-based environment.
- A confident and professional telephone manner, alongside strong written communication skills.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook and Excel.
- Strong numerical skills and excellent attention to detail.

- A practical, problem-solving approach, with the confidence to investigate issues and find solutions.
- A team-focused attitude, alongside the ability to use your own initiative.
- A genuine commitment to providing a positive customer experience.

Experience working with thirdparty logistics providers and order management systems would be advantageous. Knowledge of Navision or Bevica would also be beneficial.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of up to 27,000.
- 25 days' annual leave, with the option to purchase up to five additional days.
- Company pension scheme.
- Professional development opportunities.
- A collaborative, supportive working environment.
- Hybrid working following successful completion of probation.

Nter Talent are managing this opportunity on behalf of our client. If you're an experienced customer service professional looking for your next opportunity, we'd be keen to hear from you.

With four positions available and a planned start date of 1st November, get in touch with Nter Talent to find out more or apply today.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Bookkeeper - Luton

Cadence Search are assisting this fast paced and growing residential property development business in seeking a Book Keeper to join their ambitious team. With multiple projects and an expanding workload they are seeking an experienced, organised and proactive Bookkeeper to take ownership of our day-to-day bookkeeping and financial administration.

Working closely with the Head of Commercial, project teams and external accountants, you will maintain accurate financial records, reconcile invoices and accounts, prepare weekly payment schedules and support effective financial control across our developments.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone who understands construction accounting, follows up discrepancies and takes pride in keeping accounts accurate and up to date.

Key responsibilities

Bookkeeping and accounting systems
- Maintain accurate and current financial records using Xero and JNC.
- Record purchase invoices, sales invoices, receipts, payments and journals.
- Allocate expenditure to the correct company, development, project and cost code.
- Reconcile bank accounts, company credit cards and other control accounts.

Purchase invoices and supplier reconciliation
- Check invoices against purchase orders, delivery records, agreed rates and authorised works.
- Obtain the appropriate approval before including invoices for payment.
- Reconcile supplier statements and investigate missing invoices, duplicate charges, credit notes and other discrepancies.
- Liaise with suppliers, subcontractors and site teams to resolve queries promptly.

CIS administration and returns
- Maintain subcontractor records and coordinate CIS verification.
- Calculate and record applicable CIS deductions.
- Prepare and submit monthly CIS returns, working with the external accountant where necessary.
- Prepare and issue subcontractor payment and deduction statements.
- Reconcile CIS liabilities and prepare payments for approval.

Weekly staff and subcontractor payments
- Collate and check approved timesheets, attendance records, agreed rates and supporting information for weekly paid staff and subcontractors.
- Reconcile proposed payments against authorised hours, work completed and relevant deductions.
- Prepare weekly payment schedules and certify that the supporting records and calculations have been checked.

VAT, month-end and accountant support
- Maintain accurate VAT records and support the preparation and submission of VAT returns.
- Apply the appropriate VAT treatment, including construction domestic reverse charge where applicable, with accountant guidance.
- Complete regular month-end reconciliations and provide information for management accounts.

Cash flow and financial reporting
- Prepare weekly payment forecasts and maintain visibility of upcoming commitments.
- Monitor outstanding customer balances and follow up overdue payments.
- Provide regular summaries of bank balances, creditors, debtors and outstanding queries.

Essential experience and skills
- Proven bookkeeping experience, ideally within construction or property development.
- Practical experience of CIS administration and returns.
- Strong working knowledge of Xero.
- Experience checking weekly payroll or subcontractor payment schedules.
- Strong invoice, supplier statement and bank reconciliation skills.
- Good Excel skills and confidence working with accounting systems.

Desirable
- Experience using JNC.
- AAT qualification, bookkeeping qualification or equivalent practical experience. (Crestview are willing to fund an AAT course if the preferred candidate wishes to progress their career).

title: Credit Controller
description:
Role Purpose
- To support the timely collection of outstanding customer debts, minimise overdue balances and support the cash flow of the business. The role involves proactively managing customer accounts, resolving payment queries and maintaining accurate records, whilst building positive customer relationships and ensuring compliance with company credit control procedures.

Key Responsibilities
- Debt Collection: Proactively chase overdue balances by telephone and email, maintain accurate records of customer interactions and credit control activity on k 8, and ensure monthly statements and credit chase streams are processed promptly.
- Customer Accounts: Manage a portfolio of accounts, including key customers, encouraging timely payments in line with agree credit terms.
- Credit Management: Monitor overdue accounts, apply and release credit stops in accordance with company procedures, and review customer credit limits.
- Query Resolution: Work closely with customers, branches and sales teams to resolve invoice disputes and outstanding queries promptly.
- Debt Recovery: Identify potentially problematic debts, issue formal payment notices and escalate accounts for legal recovery where necessary.
- Account Administration: Process new credit applications, set up accounts on k 8 and CRM, and maintain accurate customer records.
- Payment Processing: Process customer card payments, authorised settlement discounts, credit adjustments and write-offs.
- Account Adjustments: Process authorised customer settlement discounts, credit notes and bad debt write-offs.
- Reporting and Housekeeping: Maintain accurate collection notes, monitor outstanding invoices and review dormant customer accounts.
- Group Support: Provide holiday cover and support consistent credit control procedures across the Group.

Skills and Experience
- Previous credit control or accounts receivable experience.
- Confident communicator with strong negotiation and customer service skills.
- Organised, proactive and able to manage competing priorities.
- Good attention to detail and ability to resolve problems efficiently.
- Competent in Microsoft Excel, Outlook and accounting systems.
- Experience of Kerridge k 8 and the construction or distribution sector would be advantageous.

Personal Attributes
- A proactive, organised and commercially aware individual with a firm but professional approach to debt collection. Able to work independently, build positive customer relationships and contribute effectively to the wider finance team.

title: Patient Co-ordinator, Langford, North Somerset
salary_text: £12.9 per hour (NHS Pension + Monday-Friday shift pattern)
description:
Patient Co-ordinator, Langford

Progressive GP Group of Practices

Looking for a career that matters?

Every day, thousands of patients contact the practices in this large, innovative group looking for help, advice and support.

As a Patient Co-ordinator, you'll be the first person they speak to.

You'll listen, guide, reassure and help patients access the right healthcare professional or service. It's a role where your communication skills, empathy and ability to stay calm under pressure can genuinely make a difference to someone's day.

No healthcare experience? No problem.

We can teach you the systems. We can teach you the processes. You will already have developed transferrable skills and qualities in your career to date.

If you're personable, organised, reliable and enjoy helping others, we'd love to hear from you.

Why join this group?

We're one of the largest and most innovative group of GP practices in the South West, caring for more than 85,000 patients across 10 sites throughout Bristol, North Somerset and South Gloucestershire.

We've invested heavily in our people, systems and facilities, creating modern working environments and a supportive culture where people can build long-term careers.

What you can expect:
- Detailed training from day one
- Structured induction and ongoing support
- Weekly one-to-one meetings during probation
- Monday and Wednesday full days 8:00am-6:30pm
- Supportive team environment
- Opportunities for career progression
- Continuous learning and development

A career, not just a job

Many of our Patient Co-ordinators go on to develop their careers within the organisation.

Previous team members have progressed into Medical Secretary, Healthcare Assistant and management positions. One former Patient Co-ordinator even progressed into an HCA role before going on to study Medicine.

If you're ambitious and eager to learn, we'll support your development every step of the way.

What you'll be doing

As a Patient Co-ordinator, you'll be at the heart of our patient services team.

You'll:
- Be the first point of contact for patients contacting the practice
- Help patients access the most appropriate healthcare service
- Manage appointment requests and bookings
- Provide excellent customer service both over the phone and face-to-face
- Support patients with enquiries and administrative requests
- Create and maintain accurate patient records
- Process correspondence and documentation
- Work closely with GPs, nurses and other healthcare professionals
- Help ensure patients receive a safe, efficient and positive experience
- Every day is different, and every interaction matters.

Hours

30 hour post on Mondays, Wednesdays and Fridays

What we're looking for

You don't need healthcare experience.

We're particularly interested in hearing from people with customer service backgrounds in:
- Retail
- Hospitality
- Customer service
- Reception
- Contact centres
- Front-of-house roles

You'll be:
- A confident communicator
- Comfortable speaking with people on the phone
- Compassionate and patient-focused
- Organised and able to manage multiple tasks
- Comfortable using computers, email and Microsoft Office
- Calm under pressure
- Keen to learn and develop

Essential
- GCSE English and Maths (or equivalent experience)
- Experience in a customer-facing role
- Strong communication skills
- Commitment to delivering excellent service

Desirable
- Experience within a GP surgery or healthcare setting
- Knowledge of EMIS or patient record systems
- Administration experience

What our team says

"No one expects you to know everything when you start. The training and support are fantastic, and there's always someone willing to help."

At this group of GP practices, you'll join a team that genuinely cares about patients and each other.

Ready to make a difference?

If you're looking for a rewarding role where you can help people every day, learn new skills and build a long-term career, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and become part of a team that puts patients first.

Kirsty Morris

title: Assistant Logistics Coordinator
description:

- Role: Assistant Logistics Coordinator

- Pay: 14 - 16 p/hr (Inside IR35)
- Location: Bedfordshire (Fully onsite)

- Reviewing and validating customs declarations and shipping documentation.
- Liaising with freight forwarders, customs brokers and suppliers to resolve shipment queries.
- Managing import and export records, ensuring complete audit trails and compliance documentation.

- Assisting with CBAM reporting requirements and trade compliance activities.

- Aerospace, manufacturing, engineering or similar environment experience

- Strong understanding of import/export processes and customs procedures.
- Knowledge of commodity codes, customs documentation and UK customs legislation.
- Experience liaising with customs brokers, freight providers and external stakeholders.
- Excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- SAP experience

This is an exciting opportunity to join a busy and collaborative environment where no two days are the same.

If you're local to Bedfordshire, looking for a new role to develop your logistics and customs expertise within a dynamic business and happy to be fully onsite, apply now!
